description: Toggle email-on-submit notifications for a specific user on a form view. Per-user, not per-form (separate from set_form_metadata).

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

shouldEnable.description: true to send email-on-submit, false to stop

userId.description: The Airtable user ID to enable/disable notifications for (usr-prefixed)

name: set_form_submission_notification
